name: Ishmerai
overview: Ishmerai is a male figure from the tribe of Benjamin, identified uniquely as the son of Elpaal. The biblical record provides limited information about him beyond his lineage, situating him within the genealogical context of Benjaminite descendants.
namesAndTitles: The name Ishmerai means 'y-h-v-h guards,' reflecting a theologically significant name that acknowledges God's protective care. This proper name is recorded in 1 Chronicles 8:18 and is not indicated as being given directly by God.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Ishmerai as the son of Elpaal, establishing a clear paternal relationship. No other family relationships are documented in the biblical text beyond this connection.
scriptureSignificance: Ishmerai’s significance lies primarily in his place within the genealogical records of the tribe of Benjamin, as preserved in 1 Chronicles. His mention helps to trace the lineage and heritage of the Benjaminite people, contributing to the biblical narrative of Israel’s tribal history and God's providential preservation of His chosen people.
